translations.translatedText: # Friday 21.8.2020 (radio)

Corona's financial difficulties continue in many families. Finland takes part in the EU's vaccine procurement. Finns returned to buy alcohol in Estonia. The corona situation may change the Presidential Castle reception. The weather.
## Families' corona hardship continues

![Hope ry volunteer Anja Salmi shows a sports shirt she received as a donation. ](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5120,h_2880,x_0,y_480/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-7099845f3e28d1a1ce5/1597909629)
Open image viewer
An aid worker sorts clothes that people have donated. Food and clothes are needed in many families where there is little money. Photo: Milka Krogerus / Yle
In many families the bad financial situation continues because of the corona situation. In many families the money is not enough if, for example, a mother or father has become unemployed or laid off.
The family aid organisation *Hope* says that it is now being asked for a lot of help.
For example, clothes, hygiene products and food aid are needed in many families.
## Finland joins the EU vaccine procurement
![A Finnish flag and an EU flag.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4866,h_2737,x_0,y_456/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-6731635eb693b5a04b3/1589096939)
Open image viewer
The Finnish flag and the EU flag. Photo: Silja Viitala / Yle
Finland is taking part in the EU's joint procurement of a coronavirus vaccine.
The European Commission has made an agreement with the pharmaceutical company AstraZeneca that the EU may buy the corona vaccine from the company when the vaccine is ready.

It is easier for EU countries to get the vaccine together, because the EU is a big customer for the pharmaceutical company. Finland has decided that Finland takes part in the joint procurement of the vaccine.
## Finns are again visiting alcohol shops in Tallinn

![Miikka Riikonen from Helsinki and Juha Tunttunen from Tuusula bought beer and cider in Tallinn to take home. In their opinion, the prices of drinks in Estonia are so much lower than in Finland that it is worth carrying them across the sea.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11504577)
Open image viewer
Miikka Riikonen and Juha Tunttunen bought beer and cider in Tallinn. Photo: Silja Massa
Finnish tourists have returned to the alcohol shops in Estonia. The spring was quiet in the alcohol shops in Estonia, because travel stopped because of the corona situation.

Now Finns have been to the alcohol shops in Estonia again. The Estonian alcohol shops say that sales volumes have returned to normal. Some Finns have also bought more alcohol than before. Of the customers at the alcohol shops at the Tallinn port, most, up to 80 per cent, are Finns.
The Estonian alcohol shops are afraid that the corona situation may stop travel again in the autumn.
## The Presidential Castle reception may have to be held in a new way
![The presidential couple dance at the Independence Day reception at the Presidential Palace in 2016](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11090836)
Open image viewer
President Sauli Niinistö and Mrs Jenni Haukio at the Castle reception in 2016. Photo: AOP
The Independence Day reception of the President of the Republic, that is, the Castle reception, may be held in a new way this year.

The office of President Sauli Niinistö is considering how the reception can be held. Because of the corona situation, guests may not be invited to the Presidential Palace, because the palace is cramped.
The President's Independence Day reception is on Finland's Independence Day, that is, 6 December. The President's office will say later in the autumn how the reception will be held.
## The weather
![Rain clouds over Lake Tuusula.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11465036)
Open image viewer
Rain clouds. Photo: Heikki Saukkomaa / Lehtikuva
On Saturday it will rain in the west. The rain may be heavy in the west. In the afternoon and evening showers of rain will spread to the rest of Finland too. The temperature is about 20 degrees.
